## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- God function: <module> in docs/site/chapters.js calls 539 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- Circular dependency (critical): core ↔ core-graph is a two-way import cycle (72 out, 26 back). Move the shared graph types into core-graph or into a lower-level module that both can import, so the edge runs one way. [warning] (core)
- Circular dependency (critical): core ↔ core-document is a two-way import cycle (28 out, 18 back). Route the document index through a single interface owned by core-document so core stops importing its internals. [warning] (core)
- Leaky boundary (warning): packages/core/src/cli/ is part of core but only partly covered by the Core Cli zone. Decide whether the whole directory belongs to Core Cli and move its files, or document which subcommands stay in core. [warning] (core)

### Patterns

- Clean boundary (info): core-theme and core-sync are reached by one-way imports only (11 and 7 from core). These are well-defined dependencies that can be kept as they are. [info] (core)
- Clean boundary (info): core-cli depends on core in one direction only (18 imports), which matches the dispatch layout in which the graview CLI hands subcommands to core/cli. [info] (core)

### Relationships

- Tightly coupled modules: packages/studio/src/edits.ts and packages/studio/src/source.ts — 57 cross-file calls (unidirectional). Consider extracting shared interface or merging [info]

### Observations

- 13 entry points — wide API surface, consider consolidating exports [warning] (apps)
- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps)
- Files in zone "Apps" appear to serve unrelated purposes; a maintainer would expect them in separate modules. [info] (apps)
- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps-discography)
- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps-gauntlet)
- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps-todo)
- 42 entry points — wide API surface, consider consolidating exports [warning] (core)
- Zones "Core" and "Capabilities Formats" may be one architectural concept; the import graph links them but the judgment was undecided. [info] (core)
- High coupling (0.76) — 18 imports target "core" [warning] (core-cli)
- Low cohesion (0.24) — files are loosely related, consider splitting this zone [warning] (core-cli)
- ... and 50 more

### Suggestions

- Zone "apps" has files across 18 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (apps)
- Zone "core" has files across 15 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core)
- Zone "core-graph" has files across 5 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core-graph)
- Zone "Core Graph" is fragile and needs refactoring before new feature development — cohesion: 0.33, coupling: 0.67 (risk score: 0.67) [warning] (core-graph)
- packages/core/src/ contains files from 3 zones (capabilities-formats, core, core-graph) — consider grouping into subdirectories to clarify architectural boundaries [info]
- Hub function: portFor in scripts/lib/ports.mjs is called from 26 files (high fan-in expected for this module type) — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- 5 potentially unused exports in packages/pages/src/page-places.tsx have no incoming calls: PlacePicture, GalleryCard, PlaceCard, DefaultPlacesPage, DefaultPlacePage [warning]
- 4 potentially unused exports in packages/core/src/cli/check/relations.ts have no incoming calls: checkReadings, checkEdgeNamesAgree, checkActsFromEnds, checkUnmakeable [info]
- 3 potentially unused exports in packages/primitives/src/workbench/activity.tsx have no incoming calls: UndoTurn, StartFresh, ActivityRail [info]
